SPARC American History Progressive

This prototype demonstrates progressive SPARC construction: a short chapter opening, a multiple-choice activity, remediation nodes appended for incorrect choices, and a fill-in challenge appended after the correct choice.

sparcsession.calculateProbability: p.y = -0.77 + .665 * pFunc.logitdec( p.overallOutcomeHistory.slice( Math.max(p.overallOutcomeHistory.length-60, 0),  p.overallOutcomeHistory.length),  .966)+ .51* (p.stimSuccessCount) + 11.1 * pFunc.recency(p.stimSecsSinceLastShown, .443) ; p.probability = 1.0 / (1.0 + Math.exp(-p.y)); return p
